axis.why: the stack (pawl zone + rack + tube + clearance) puts the most-fore axis at -11.5 with a 2 mm fore wall; the printed BL-045 axis (-25.65) would need the fore face 15.9 mm further toward the wearer, where the yoke passes. The legs' plane (-9.81) leaves a 3.7 mm fore wall and a 6.8 mm aft wall inside the bag envelope, and is where the beam model already has the spine.

mass.basis: channel: print-mesh volume with / without add_channel x 1.06 g/cm3 (pre-simplify); clamp: crown_spine_clamp.size_clamp (real crown)

clamp.source: crown_spine_clamp.size_clamp: frame model TB1 forces (crown_diet kits, rev C), huntkit.fea.joints.bond_check, H1 STL spine channel; ASSUMPTIONS CLAMP-TYPE, CLAMP-WALL, SPINE-AXIS, TRANSVERSE-SHEAR

interfaces.spine_axis_rule: aft face - (tube r + running clearance) (BL-046 tube channel)

run_plan_mm.note: run = plan length from the mitre centre (aft face of the bar) to its tangent on the spine wrap; the spine wrap (one full turn) is unchanged

b25.source: crown_spine_clamp.b25_clearances (corrie_f.b25_topology checks; real clamp + H1 STL)

PAWL-ZONE: The pawl's swing zone is 9.3 mm deep fore of the rack's tooth tips, the room it had in the printed channel (18.3 = 3 plate + 6 rack + 9.3); the pawl pivots on a 4 mm pin through the side walls.
Pawl dry fit on the first print: pawl fully lifted (2 mm tooth depth + 0.5) clears the fore wall.
RUN-CLEAR: 1.0 mm running clearance on the tube (radial) and each side of the rack: FDM hole tolerance 0.3 + tube OD tolerance 0.1 + 0.6 for grit and ice.
Slide the bonded spine + rack through the printed housing by hand over the full travel, dry and with grit, before bonding the clamp.
RACK-SADDLE: The flat rack sits on the tube's fore face on a filled-adhesive saddle (MMA with glass beads), so the moving envelope is the tube plus a 20 x 16 mm block from the tube axis to the tooth tips.
Bond trial on a spine offcut; the rack's base must seat flat.
YOKE-PATH: The housing's fore face stays at today's y -38.8 (at the pawl line): the yoke on the spine passes it at S 16.8-18 in and M 17.5-18.3 in (geometry.yaml yoke anchors y -38.5..-42.3).
Crown dry fit at kit S 18 in: the yoke slides past the housing.
GUIDE-B: Moving pulley guide B hangs from the tube's lower end, centred on the tube axis, its 39 mm across x; at each kit's top setting it enters the housing from below (tube end 15.8 mm below the pawl line).
Crown dry fit at each kit's top setting.
TOP-BAR-AFT: The crown top bar runs 25 mm aft of the legs' plane at x 0 (geometry.yaml top_bar_aft_offset_mm, corner dog-legs from x 103 to the leg); the beam model's top bar lies in the legs' plane. real_crown moves the top bar and models the dog-legs as straight members from the leg top to x 95 (the existing split node).
T6 coupon of the clamp fitting on the real offset; crown dry fit.
CLAMP-OFFSET: The clamp's T-fitting spans the 25 mm from the top-bar axis to the spine axis as a solid machined block (saddle, socket and two webs); modelled as a 25 mm 7075 beam with the webs' section.
